writeup: TIC 403364360 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 19.6758 days. TESS photometry reveals a primary eclipse with a dimming of 0.36%, detected with a signal-to-noise ratio of 74.0 in the Box Least Squares search. No secondary eclipse was detected. Pixel-level image analysis confirms the signal is centered near the target, with a difference-imaging peak signal-to-noise of 14.3, though the centroid offset measures 19.0 arcsec from the catalog position. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, making it a previously unknown object. The machine-learning screening score of 0.79 indicates the automated pipeline considers this a promising target. No data quality flags were raised during processing.
